definitions.current: recap.json model_result (the site's pick), same as summary.json
definitions.shadow: shadow_side vs recap result (candidate stats: Phase 2 fit; other stats carry the current pick)
definitions.hit_rate: hits / (hits + misses); pushes, DNPs, voids and no-pick rows excluded
definitions.paired: only rows where BOTH current and shadow made a decided pick (apples-to-apples hit rate)
definitions.mae: paired rows with an actual where both projections exist (legacy KBO pitcher cg scores excluded)
definitions.mae_shadow_all: shadow MAE over every row with an actual (includes rows without a current projection)
definitions.top_bucket: rows flagged top_current / top_shadow in shadow.json (top 20% of standard lines by |projection - line| / stat MAE, chosen pregame)
